Choose your training route

Three core routes for a provider with one base. If you are not sure which applies, start with the comparison.

  • Rigid lorries

    Category C

    Practical training for rigid goods vehicles over 3.5 tonnes, for drivers moving up from a car licence.

    View Category C

  • Articulated and drawbar

    Category C+E

    Trailer training for drivers who already hold Category C and need the articulated or drawbar entitlement.

    View Category C+E

    Driver CPC

    Periodic training for professional drivers. This demonstration does not list a course code, a date or an approval number.

Why train with us

Example wording for a small provider. No statistics, awards or pass rates are shown.

  • One training base

    Training is arranged from a single location. Meeting points are confirmed when you enquire, not published as a list of towns.

  • Straightforward advice

    The entitlement, the training and the next step are explained before you are asked to commit.

  • Practical training

    Time in the vehicle covers the manoeuvres and the road driving the test involves.

  • Local knowledge

    Road work reflects the area around that base, rather than a page for every nearby town.

How HGV training works

A simple sequence. Durations are not stated, because none are published on this demonstration.

  1. Say what you want to drive

    Category C, Category C+E or Driver CPC. If you are not sure, say so and the provider can talk it through.

  2. Check what you already hold

    The provider looks at your current licence and explains any medical, theory or CPC steps that sit alongside the practical training. This site does not confirm eligibility.

  3. Train from the local base

    Practical sessions are arranged from one training location. This demonstration does not publish a timetable.

  4. Prepare for the next step

    That may be a practical test or periodic CPC hours. How booking works is explained when you enquire. No result is claimed here.

Questions

Which licence do I need?

Category C is the usual route onto a rigid lorry. Category C+E adds a trailer. Driver CPC is the professional qualification, not a vehicle category. The HGV training page compares them, and you can ask if you are not sure.

Do you publish prices?

No. This demonstration does not list a fee. The enquiry form is how you ask for a quote on a live site.

Where does the training take place?

From one base. The town on this demonstration is a placeholder, and no street address is published. Directions are shared when training is being arranged.

Are the reviews real?

No. The quotations are samples for the layout. A live site should only show feedback the provider can stand behind. No rating is shown here.
